dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product puts a short row of actions for the current screen or selection across the bottom edge on some screens and floating over the content on others (an editor's tools, a map's controls), horizontal or, beside the content on a large screen, vertical.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a toolbar reads: for each variant (docked: across the bottom edge; floating: a rounded surface over the content) the container color, elevation, corners, cross-axis size, end padding, minimum gap between items and edge color, and the width of that edge.
rules: The toolbar has no interaction states: its items are the product's icon buttons and buttons, with their own tokens, which the toolbar does not restyle.
docked and floating must differ visibly at rest: a floating toolbar is raised and rounded, a docked one is flush with the screen's bottom edge.
container.size is the extent across the row of items: the height of a horizontal toolbar, the width of a vertical one. It is a minimum.
A container color must keep the items' own icon and label colors readable: a standard icon button draws on-surface-variant on it.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.

floating.$description: White in light schemes, lighter than the page in dark ones, as a raised surface is.
The FAB's level: a floating toolbar sits over the content as a FAB does. Level 1 is only a hairline ring in the default system, so a raised surface needs level 2 or more.

docked.$description: A docked toolbar is flush with the screen's edges.

size.$description: The extent across the row of items: the height of a horizontal toolbar, the width of a vertical one, not counting a docked toolbar's system inset. A minimum: a button's enlarged label grows it.

padding-inline.$description: From each end of the toolbar, along its axis, to the first and the last item.

floating.$description: Equal to the space across the row around a medium item (64 − 40 = 2 × 12), so the items sit evenly inside the rounded ends.

gap.$description: Between the visible bounds of two neighbouring items. docked: the least space between them in a toolbar that spreads its items across its width; neighbouring hit areas meet at the middle of it (TBR-9), so it is what keeps each item's target whole: at sys.target.touch minus an item's length or more, the item keeps its full target between neighbours, and the default system's 16 is 48 minus its narrowest icon button (small, 32). floating: the space between items in a toolbar that is as long as its items need; 0 in the default system, where the items stand as close as their targets allow, each keeping sys.target.touch along the axis (TBR-16), so medium icon buttons (40) stand 8 apart and items 48 or longer touch.

color.$description: A docked toolbar's top edge; the edge around a floating toolbar's whole shape.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A floating toolbar is set apart by its elevation, not by an edge.
